meta.notes: The depot: a motor pool at night. Three huts round a floodlit yard inside a wall; the dark signals hut and the store's hatch hold the lit yard between them, and the hut's own door and the mains are at its back. One floor, box geometry only, the office's kit. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts depot — IN THE DEFAULT LOOK (2010s GWOT: tools/levels/gwotSkin.ts): the same boxes repainted, decals added; what a man collides with, hides behind or sees through is the plain file's.

response.why: A motor pool has trucks out on the road at night with an armed escort, and the signals hut is what talks to them: gunfire the hut hears brings the escort back to one of the depot's own two gates. The hut taken first (the level's own answer, round the back) and nobody calls.
